Please take a moment

Pet travel guidance for Aurelia Skyways

Travelers should check in early, keep carriers ready, and follow staff directions so pets and people move through the airport with less stress.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports each trip with calm guidance and clear steps. Staff will help you prepare documents, review carrier fit, and plan for comfort at every stage. <<FACT F014>> If your pet needs a break, use the pet relief area and ask the welcome team for the safest route.

Before boarding, make sure food, water, and any required supplies are packed in a way that is easy to reach. The cabin team watches animals during flight and gives patient attention throughout the journey. <<FACT F012>> Please keep your carrier closed unless a staff member asks you to open it.

For personal help, visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate.
